disposition_reason: Only soil (91 samples) and cow fecal samples were analysed for lead and cadmium; no milk or other food was measured. Milk values in the introduction are quoted from other studies.

study.design: Environmental survey of soil and cow feces at three dairy farms with pollution indices
study.origin: three dairy farms (A, B, C), Jiangsu, China
study.method: Soil aqua regia digestion; Pb and Cd by spectrometry; feces mixed from six cows per farm

unresolved: No milk, feed or food measured; soil and feces results are not findings.
Commercial milk Pb values for Jiangsu (35.01 µg/kg) and other provinces are quoted from other studies in the Introduction, not extracted.
